scenicChapters.narrative: Slow enough to look. The surface follows the shoreline, so the corners arrive where the water decided, not where an engineer did. Water arrives beside the road and stays for 63 km. The line follows the shore because there is nowhere else for it to go.

scenicChapters.title: Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 16 km this is Saint Petersburg Imperial Shore, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.

places-the-zubov-s-estate-otrada-izhorsk.story: A 70 km round trip from Lomonosov - roughly 1 h 12 in the saddle. The stops in between: The Water-bringing system of Peterhof, Izhorsky Bench and back through The Water-bringing system of Peterhof. It was put together for the scenery rather than the shortest line.
